name: TEN-T0 tennis baseline
archiveReason: TEN-T0 mixed slate generation, market-watch inventory, DB fallback inputs, and prediction capture. It is retained for forensic reproduction only and must not publish production prediction rows.
summary: Archived forensic tennis cartridge for the Roland Garros pipeline after the May 31 value-book and derivative-lane cleanup. TEN-T0 is retained for diagnosis and reproducibility only; it is not an active prediction model.
keyImprovements: Separated the active tennis model into a cartridge/run stack so future TEN-T1+ changes can be compared against a frozen TEN-T0 baseline.
Made ML, spread, match O/U, first-set O/U, set-win, and Kalshi trade-to-sell separate lanes instead of blending them into one vague confidence number.
Added postmatch settlement and backtest surfaces so model accuracy, lane hit rate, and ROI can be tracked by day.
Kept source-site predictions as context only; the cartridge prediction lanes are expected to come from warehouse features, market lines, and model gates.

notes: TEN-T0 is archived and must not be used for production prediction publication.
TEN-T0 exists only so forensic audits can reproduce the old May 31 prediction shape.
May 30 is the closest settled TEN-T0-compatible validation slate, but it was produced before formal cartridge run snapshots existed.
Prediction-market trade-to-sell is not the same model objective as picking the match winner; it must stay separately graded.
Future cartridges should explain what changed, what got better, what got worse, and which lane the change is supposed to improve.
Blind ML value remains downgraded until bucketed EV and ROI improve in settled postmatch runs.
knownLimitations: May 30 is legacy pre-cartridge history, so it is shown under the legacy tennis archive rather than TEN-T0 settlement.
Derivative lanes are only as strong as the captured FanDuel and Kalshi line coverage.
TEN-T0 mixed slate generation, market-watch inventory, DB fallback inputs, and prediction capture; it should not be rehabilitated into an active betting engine.
